verdict.rationale: As a Python/JS SDK, the Agents SDK is inherently headless—Runner.run()/run_sync()/run_streamed() are plain programmatic APIs with no UI dependency, and env vars like OPENAI_DEFAULT_MODEL and OPENAI_AGENTS_DISABLE_TRACING support scripted/CI configuration. Missing for 10: no explicit CI/CD pipeline examples (e.g., GitHub Actions) or documented automation recipes, and no independent report confirming CI usage.
